android.desc:
Introducing FloatingAI, your ever-present AI assistant designed to float on your phone screen. It can understand all the information on the current screen and provide suggestions based on your instructions. Use your own API key or get started with our free credits.

New in 4.0: Ask any question about the current page content and get instant AI-powered answers.

It can be used with any app, such as:

1. Offering suggestions for the next reply in any chat app, helping you handle relationships with ease.
2. Providing comments from a supporter's or opponent's perspective on content pages like Twitter or Facebook.
3. Summarizing or extracting key points from any content.
4. Asking questions about articles, products, or people mentioned on the current screen.
5. Getting explanations of complex topics or terms visible on your page.

You can also create your own prompts, allowing GPT to read your phone and assist you in various tasks!

FloatingAI supports inputting your OpenAI API Key (no need to pay for FloatingAI) or using the GPT features provided by FloatingAI.

Make your smartphone even smarter right now!

Accessibility Permission Description:
To better assist you, FloattingAI needs to access the content of the current page and send it to GPT. This requires the accessibility service to be turned on, but don’t worry - we only send information when you click the button, and we do not collect any data at any other time. If you use your own OpenAI API Key, we won’t send any data on our servers.

quotes.text:
We have developed an Android Accessibility Service App that can help users in any app by utilizing the OpenAI API.

You may use your own API key at no cost, or take advantage of our cloud service, which offers 30 free requests.

There are three built-in prompts to help users reply, summarize, or comment. You can also add your own prompts. If you find some prompts very helpful, maybe you can share them here. Thank you.
